title: Grateful Dead Live at Stadium, U.C Santa Barbara on 1973-05-20
source: 2 Source Matrix by dusborne Soundboard (shinid:86905) Recording Info: SBD -> Master Reel (7 inch reels @ 7.5ips 1/2trk) -> Dat -> CD; Transfer Info: CD -> EAC -> Samplitude Professional v9.11 -> FLAC; All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller and Audience (shnid:5915) MC>R>C>DAT>HD>SHN>CD

ai_review.summary: Stellar matrix recording delivers a warm, crisp sound that captures a thrilling show highlighted by an electrifying Other One.
ai_review.review: All five‑star reviews rave about the vibrant, crisp matrix mix—thanks to Dusborne and Charlie Miller—that preserves the live energy while sounding studio‑clean. The performance itself is described as “great from start to finish,” with particular praise for a soaring finale of The Other One and Jerry’s impassioned (if slightly hoarse) vocals. Minor tape hiss and cracks are noted but don’t detract from the overall awe‑inspiring experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently five‑star feedback highlights both an excellent matrix recording and a high‑energy, flawless performance, leaving little doubt of top‑tier quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Warm, vibrant, crisp sound with stellar balance; some tape hiss and tiny cracks mentioned but overall superb clarity—far superior to flat soundboard or muddy audience mixes.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth progression from opening acts through a high‑energy Dead set; the show maintains momentum and excitement throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His guitar wails at the end of The Other One are praised; vocals noted as slightly hoarse but still powerful.
